BrochureContent.Content:
DNG McCormack Properties are delighted to present 45 Liffey Lawns, Clane, Co. Kildare to the market a superb three-bedroom, two-bathroom detached family bungalow ideally positioned within one of Clane's most established and sought-after residential developments.

Presented in good condition throughout, this bright and spacious home offers well-proportioned accommodation perfectly suited to modern family living. A welcoming entrance hall leads to a comfortable living room, while the well-appointed kitchen/dining area provides an ideal space for both everyday living and entertaining. There are three generously sized bedrooms, including a master bedroom with ensuite, together with a contemporary family bathroom.

Externally, the property enjoys a large private rear garden, offering an excellent space for relaxing, outdoor dining and entertaining. To the front, there is off-street parking, while the adjoining garage provides valuable storage and offers excellent potential for conversion or further development, subject to the necessary planning permission.

Liffey Lawns is a mature, family-friendly development located just a short stroll from the centre of Clane village. Residents benefit from an excellent selection of local amenities, including supermarkets, cafés, restaurants, boutiques, primary and secondary schools, churches, sporting facilities and picturesque riverside walks. Clane is also exceptionally well connected, with convenient access to the M4 and M7 motorways, while both Sallins and Maynooth train stations are within easy driving distance, providing regular commuter services to Dublin.

Combining spacious accommodation, excellent potential and a prime location, 45 Liffey Lawns presents an outstanding opportunity for first-time buyers, growing families, those looking to downsize and investors alike.

Early viewing is highly recommended. To arrange an appointment, contact DNG McCormack Properties on 045 832535.
